convert_encoder_checkpoint: convert a fairseq Sonar text encoder checkpoint state dict to fairseq2 format
convert_decoder_checkpoint: convert a fairseq Sonar text decoder checkpoint state dict to fairseq2 format
remap_encoder_keys: remap fairseq encoder layer keys to fairseq2 encoder layer naming convention
remap_decoder_keys: remap fairseq decoder layer keys to fairseq2 decoder layer naming convention
reorder_control_embeddings: reorder BOS, PAD, EOS, UNK token embeddings to match SentencePiece tokenizer order
